function.name: get_customer_context
function.description: Get the fixed authenticated customer's own profile and organization memberships. No identity argument.

function.name: get_organization
function.description: Read an organization. On success also discover related invoice IDs; subscription ID is in the entity.

resource_id.description: Target organization, subscription, invoice or membership ID

function.name: list_members
function.description: Read organization memberships and related public user profiles; resource_id must equal org_id.

resource_id.description: Target organization, subscription, invoice or membership ID

function.name: get_subscription
function.description: Read the actual subscription, plan, seats, renewal and billing period.

resource_id.description: Target organization, subscription, invoice or membership ID

function.name: get_invoice
function.description: Read a specific invoice, paid amount, original payment method and refund history. Permissions are enforced.

resource_id.description: Target organization, subscription, invoice or membership ID

function.name: change_plan
function.description: Change the subscription plan requested by the customer; the current seats must fit the target plan.

resource_id.description: Target organization, subscription, invoice or membership ID

function.name: change_seats
function.description: Change subscription seats. Respect plan capacity and active member count.

resource_id.description: Target organization, subscription, invoice or membership ID

function.name: cancel_renewal
function.description: Disable automatic renewal without changing the current service period.

resource_id.description: Target organization, subscription, invoice or membership ID

function.name: refund_invoice
function.description: Refund a positive amount no greater than the remaining refundable balance within the refund window to the original method. idempotency_key is required; exact retries do not refund twice.

resource_id.description: Target organization, subscription, invoice or membership ID

function.name: change_member_role
function.description: Change a member's role as requested. Only the owner can manage roles; owner transfer is unsupported.

resource_id.description: Target organization, subscription, invoice or membership ID

function.name: invite_member
function.description: Owner provisions a known directory user in this organization with a pending membership. resource_id is the organization ID. Duplicate pending invitations with the same role are idempotent.

resource_id.description: Target organization, subscription, invoice or membership ID

function.name: activate_member
function.description: Owner activates a pending or inactive non-owner membership. Requires an active subscription and a free seat. This is administrator provisioning, not acting as the invited user.

resource_id.description: Target organization, subscription, invoice or membership ID

function.name: deactivate_member
function.description: Owner suspends an active non-owner membership, reducing the active seat requirement.

resource_id.description: Target organization, subscription, invoice or membership ID

function.name: remove_member
function.description: Owner removes a pending or inactive non-owner membership. Active members must first be deactivated.

resource_id.description: Target organization, subscription, invoice or membership ID

function.name: pay_invoice
function.description: Simulated full invoice payment. card_declined records failure; other supported methods succeed. Exact invoice/key/method retry returns the original result; changing method needs a fresh key. Never charges real money.

resource_id.description: Target organization, subscription, invoice or membership ID

function.name: issue_renewal
function.description: Create or retrieve the linked next 30-day renewal invoice for this subscription. Returns invoice ID and period. Active cycles start at current end; expired cycles start at frozen business time.

resource_id.description: Target organization, subscription, invoice or membership ID

function.name: renew_subscription
function.description: Extend an active subscription with its paid, unrefunded next-cycle invoice. invoice_id must link to this subscription and the correct period.

resource_id.description: Target organization, subscription, invoice or membership ID

function.name: reactivate_subscription
function.description: Restore an expired subscription with its paid, unrefunded renewal invoice starting at frozen business time.

resource_id.description: Target organization, subscription, invoice or membership ID

function.name: expire_subscription
function.description: Record expiration only when the service period has ended at frozen business time; disables automatic renewal.

resource_id.description: Target organization, subscription, invoice or membership ID

resource_id.description: Target organization, subscription, invoice or membership ID

function.name: deactivate_member
function.description: Owner suspends an active non-owner membership, reducing the active seat requirement.

resource_id.description: Target organization, subscription, invoice or membership ID

function.name: remove_member
function.description: Owner removes a pending or inactive non-owner membership. Active members must first be deactivated.

resource_id.description: Target organization, subscription, invoice or membership ID

function.name: pay_invoice
function.description: Simulated full invoice payment. card_declined records failure; other supported methods succeed. Exact invoice/key/method retry returns the original result; changing method needs a fresh key. Never charges real money.

resource_id.description: Target organization, subscription, invoice or membership ID

function.name: issue_renewal
function.description: Create or retrieve the linked next 30-day renewal invoice for this subscription. Returns invoice ID and period. Active cycles start at current end; expired cycles start at frozen business time.

resource_id.description: Target organization, subscription, invoice or membership ID

function.name: renew_subscription
function.description: Extend an active subscription with its paid, unrefunded next-cycle invoice. invoice_id must link to this subscription and the correct period.

resource_id.description: Target organization, subscription, invoice or membership ID

function.name: reactivate_subscription
function.description: Restore an expired subscription with its paid, unrefunded renewal invoice starting at frozen business time.

resource_id.description: Target organization, subscription, invoice or membership ID

function.name: expire_subscription
function.description: Record expiration only when the service period has ended at frozen business time; disables automatic renewal.

resource_id.description: Target organization, subscription, invoice or membership ID

I cannot suspend the owner's membership for organization org_000.

**Policy Code: OWNER_IMMUTABLE**

**Explanation:** The sole owner cannot be suspended, removed, assigned or transferred by member tools. The system policy explicitly states that owner transfer is unsupported.

**Current state of org_000:**
- Owner: user_000 (active)
- Other members: user_001 (member, active), user_002 (billing_admin, active), user_006 (member, pending), user_007 (member, inactive)

**What would be needed (but is not supported):**
To suspend the current owner, the system would first require transferring ownership to another member. However, the platform does not support owner transfer through any available tool. The `change_member_role` function explicitly notes that "owner transfer is unsupported."

**Result:** The workspace remains intact with no changes. The owner's membership (user_000) stays active, and all other memberships, roles, subscriptions, and billing records are unchanged.
